def equation(t, x, v, params):

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p0,p1,p2,p3,p4,p5,p6,p7,p8,p9 = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    C = np.cos(p5*t); S = np.sin(p5*t)
